name: Streamline Emojis
about: Streamline Emojis is a free, open-source icon set with 787 icons designed by Streamline. From smileys and gestures to animals, food, activities and symbols, every emoji stays crisp at any size. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Streamline Emojis free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 787 Streamline Emojis are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How can I use Streamline Emojis emoji on my website or app?
faqs.a: Copy any emoji as an SVG, PNG or WebP image, paste it as a React component, or drop the CDN link into your HTML. Because they are vectors, they stay sharp at any size – from tiny reactions to large illustrations.

faqs.q: Do Streamline Emojis include skin-tone or gender variants?
faqs.a: Some emoji sets ship skin-tone and gender variants as separate icons. Search this set (try a specific emoji name) to see which variants are included here.

faqs.q: How many Streamline Emojis are there?
faqs.a: There are 787 icons in the Streamline Emojis set, designed by Streamline. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Streamline Emojis available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
